title: NixlKVManager optimizations
body_opening:
## Motivation

This PR improves the performance of NixlKVManager by reducing CPU-side overhead in address calculation and enabling multi-threading processing for NIXL transfers initiated by the decode node. Previously, generating transfer descriptors involved nested Python loops which became a bot
